answer: Each identity must anchor one mirror buoy on the ocean, silvered for 6,000; the delta current charges 2,000 dredging per buoy already anchored, so fake k pays 6,000 + 2,000(k-1). Ten fakes cost 150,000; a hundred cost 10,500,000, growing as N squared plus 5N. Two sharing one mirror patch blur each other's reflection and the delta voids both buoys, so the cost cannot be pooled.
